answers.reply:
The Loop buildings map is pinned to the dashboard, and the dashboard carries only saved outputs, so a pinned map cannot load its own data: that is why the page will not open. The plan adds an Autark node upstream of the map, Loop buildings, whose spec holds only the Chicago Loop OSM load the map's data section holds now, and connects it into the Loop buildings map with a data edge.

The map's own spec must then drop its "data" section and draw the new node's output, its buildings on its input. The map stays pinned.

answers.reply:
On the dashboard the parks team can move the Top zip codes node's top_n slider, How many zip codes. They cannot change its zip_prefix text widget, Zip code prefix: viewers cannot change text, text list, file or dataset widgets.

Nothing they do there can change your dataflow. A viewer's change runs on the server, and it never changes the saved dataflow, its saved outputs or your Data Catalog. What a viewer's run makes is kept for 7 days.
